findings: The preserved source asks only for total combination count for an amount and coin denominations; unlimited reuse, denomination uniqueness, invalid-input policy and numeric bounds are not preserved source facts.
The candidate labels those missing conditions as an explicit executable contract.
Coin-outer iteration prevents denomination order from creating duplicate arrangements, while ascending amount permits unlimited reuse of the current denomination.
The dp[0]=1 empty-combination seed and complete-knapsack versus 0/1 traversal boundary are explained.
Independent execution matches recursive enumeration on 2400 deterministic cases and 7200 input-order permutations, including explicit zero/empty and invalid-denomination boundaries.
BigInteger avoids an unsupported fixed-width result bound.
